comparisons.peer_summary: The agreements governing the company's notes, the guarantee of Xilinx's notes, and the Revolving Credit Agreement impose restrictions that may adversely affect the ability to operate the business.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose risks related to their indebtedness and associated debt agreements impacting their ability to operate or fulfill obligations. NVDA focuses on the general adverse effect of indebtedness on financial position, cash flows, and the ability to implement strategy or fulfill contractual obligations. AMD provides more specific detail regarding the restrictions imposed by agreements governing its notes, Xilinx's notes, and Revolving Credit Agreement, stating these restrictions may adversely affect its ability to operate its business. While NVDA cites a general risk of indebtedness affecting strategy, AMD explicitly links the debt instrument restrictions to operational limitations.

sentences.text: • Our indebtedness could adversely affect our financial position and cash flows from operations and prevent us from implementing our strategy or fulfilling our contractual obligations.
◦The agreements governing our notes, our guarantee of Xilinx's notes, and our Revolving Credit Agreement impose restrictions on us that may adversely affect our ability to operate our business.
